articles.title: Sen.-elect Adam Hamilton says he’d be disappointed if Democrats focus on investigating Trump
articles.summary: Sen.-elect Adam Hamilton said that he hopes to prioritize lowering costs and that he would be “deeply disappointed” to spend two years investigating Trump.

articles.summary: Newly elected Senator Abdul El-Sayed on Friday declared Michigan “the capital of Arab America,” causing a viral reaction on social media ranging from criticism to others offering data to support his claim.

articles.title: Israeli President Herzog Tasks Eisenkot with Forming Government in Setback for Netanyahu
articles.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog announced Saturday that he will give former military chief Gadi Eisenkot the first opportunity to form Israel's next government, handing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu a significant political setback nearly two weeks after the country's parliamentary elections.

articles.title: Secret Service arrests armed Venezuelan migrant near White House over alleged Trump assassination threat
articles.summary: Secret Service officers arrested a Venezuelan migrant in Washington, D.C., after finding guns in a stolen vehicle and hearing an alleged threat against President Donald Trump.

articles.title: Secret Service finds man parked near White House with multiple firearms: Authorities
articles.summary: The suspect, Ronny Guanipa-Chrinos, allegedly made threats to kill President Donald Trump, according to DHS.

articles.title: Missile causes huge damage to skyscraper belonging to world's biggest oil company in Saudi capital Riyadh
articles.summary: Windows were blown out on several floors of the building owned by a Saudi oil giant, Aramco, in the financial district of the city.

articles.title: Saudi Aramco Tower Damaged as Yemen’s Houthis Attack Riyadh
articles.summary: The Saudi authorities said no one was hurt after “falling shrapnel” hit the building in Riyadh’s financial district — one of the highest-profile areas targeted by the Houthis.
